text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"\"A problem is a chance for you to do your best\" introduction","quality":"textual integration","description":"Uses an outside quotation as a clear opening hook and ties the response to the prompt more directly."},{"evidence":"\"I agree, because...\" and repeated explanation of lessons, new things, and methods","quality":"idea development","description":"Develops the central claim with clearer elaboration and more sustained explanation than the other essay."},{"evidence":"\"For example...\" and \"For another example...\"","quality":"supporting examples","description":"Provides multiple relevant examples to illustrate the main point and strengthen the argument."},{"evidence":"\"what it is making the problem, what it is affecting, and whom is it affecting\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"Shows somewhat better control of sentence structure and clause organization, even though errors remain."},{"evidence":"\"corporate\" for criminal and \"finale\" for finally","quality":"word choice","description":"Uses a somewhat wider range of vocabulary to express ideas, despite some inaccurate word forms."}]}
